My bad -- I broke it when I took Ben's suggestion
to rename the special function beta_log to lbeta
to avoid confusion with the density. It
should be fixed now.

- Bob

PS. The place to fix these is in:

src/stan/gm/function_signatures.hpp

That file declares all the functions and the types
of their arguments and return. I use it for type
inference and error checking in the compiler.
